valid_until: Either serving authority changes, the owner changes scope, or full wave screening revises this provisional selection. Rebind at step0 and before research/handoff.
scope: One offline NEXT-WORK selection sub-step after V1.33 source handoff and canonical reconciliation; no new baseline, pool, planned-paradigm approval, web research or integration.
owner_authority: 2026-10-18 adopted continuous source-only loop. No additional routine approval wait; integration and landing still require separate explicit authorization.

priority_decision.rationale: Existing 867 pending packages already cover much familiar home/school vocabulary. This bounded40-head scope addresses physical payment, street access, care-service and everyday vehicle/rail objects missing as exact heads in both content bases and retained pending payloads. It excludes semantic duplicates and old holds; no technical tail is used merely to meet size. The set is provisional and can shrink at full screening/research.
priority_decision.gap_extension: Discovery beyond the historical growth backlog, using root-authored familiar-word hypotheses and cached positive frequency signals. This is not an exhaustive inventory of all remaining Romanian words.
priority_decision.existing_stock_first_lane: 62 families/101 missing matching-lemma keys remain the narrower prospective integration/curation priority; no new source research is claimed for them. Their installation is not authorized, so this tick queues source discovery rather than executing that integration.

method: Compare exact normalized head against live normalization/index/labels/aliases, discovery concepts/snapshots and current Cald proxies. Exact authority hashes match primary feature working and secondary main; this does not establish GUI equivalence.

Read historical canonical records and final module-approved forms once plus V1.33 continuation. Accepted/integrated approved payloads reserve keys; held/planned/excluded/inactive observations do not become reservations. Named prior holds remain preserved.
Check canonical raw/current deferred and actual accent-preserving ReviewedUnresolved literals under unchanged policy bytes.

Manually compare known selected-sense overlaps using canonical record definitions. Missing qualified heads can still duplicate an approved concept; exclude Șină de tren and defer shopping trolley rather than count exact-string novelty as new meaning.

Do not infer full-form ownership/synonymy from a missing head. Step1 must screen every planned form and actual protected source dispositions before any web call. No ordinary paradigm or secondary lexeme is admitted here.

category_and_graph_limits: No edge is approved or constructed by selection. Step1 must predeclare 4–8 readable truthful distinct links with at least 2 current-main nodes, at least 2 same-category nodes and at most 2 current-batch nodes. The live categories above are binding metadata, not permission to recategorize or add generic filler. Older pending nodes, including Bilet/Vagon/Motor/Plastic, cannot supply installed endpoints. Missing support means held.
compound_and_subtype_limits: Scară rulantă versus pending broad Scară: distinct motorized subtype is a hypothesis, not an exact-synonym claim. Evidence must warrant a useful separate concept without stealing the broad paradigm.
Scaun cu rotile versus live Scaun and pending Cărucior: selected mobility-device subtype only; no bare Scaun/Cărucior forms reassigned. Secondary expression Cărucior cu rotile is not preapproved.
Furgonetă versus current Camion: useful subtype distinction remains to be verified, not a synonym or automatic separate-node verdict.
Coș de cumpărături is a physical hand basket hypothesis; pending laundry/waste/basketball senses stay separate. Unqualified Coș forms require full ownership/sense screening.

Card bancar, Bon fiscal, Rețetă medicală, Cheie de roți, Pompă de bicicletă and other compounds require ordinary headword morphology plus independent compound-sense evidence. Bare colliding/ambiguous forms are not admitted.

game_effect_limits.desired_source_value: Familiar physical words people may type as Cald guesses or Lanț moves, plus meaningful selected-sense associations. This states the intended gap, not current player gains.
game_effect_limits.current_typed_contract: Cald accepts text; Lanț accepts text and clicked displayed-neighbor labels. Existing exact/projection/fuzzy precedence, repeats, win identity and complete snapshots can change after integration.
game_effect_limits.other_interfaces: Intrusul/Perechi/Conexiuni submit active-board IDs. Alchimie combines owned IDs; inventory/journal search filters local display labels. No free-text alias benefit to those ID interfaces is claimed.
game_effect_limits.targets: Zero target, salience or C3 approvals. Incoming numeric floors, recognition, concreteness, opener and engine qualification remain future separate checks. Do not auto-enroll selected graph vocabulary as targets.
game_effect_limits.rounds: Zero playable rounds, boards, pairs, unique partitions, recipes or qualified routes. No graph/source count proves these properties.
game_effect_limits.care_scope: Identification of common objects/documents and narrowly true physical/use facts only; no diagnosis, dosing, clinical recommendation, treatment instructions or changed clinical ruling.
game_effect_limits.integration: No safe-to-merge or zero-disturbance claim. A separately authorized future integration must freeze actual latest feature WIP, refresh existing authorities/cascade and pass existing gates/playthroughs. Main remains secondary and landing authority separate.
